description: Cross-agency recall search (FDA + CPSC) — Search US recalls across agencies in one call: FDA enforcement reports for food, drugs and medical devices (openFDA) plus Consumer Product Safety Commission product recalls. Returns merged recalls newest first (agency, category, product, reason or hazard, classification, date, firm, remedy), totals per source, Class I count and a verdict CLASS I RECALL FOUND / RECALLS FOUND / NONE FOUND. Optional limit=1-10 per source (default 5). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: recalls_search
